scientific.integrity: All algebraic identities were derived from the source's printed cubic and coefficient definitions and independently replayed by exact symbolic computation. No claim of independent external audit is made.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects and completes only the Case-3 equilibrium multiplicity boundary; it does not prove a local bifurcation normal form, stability, persistence, or global dynamics at the triple root.

title: Exact triple-root locus in the cooperative May–Holling–Tanner equilibrium cubic
